description: edge-ncip deployment configuration template (see ADR-0013, Module configuration management).

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the edge-ncip container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the edge-ncip container (MiB)

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the edge-ncip container (MiB)

deployment.description: edge-ncip is stateless and supports multiple replicas. Adjust replicas based on expected NCIP request volume.

kong.description: Read timeout set to 120s so slow NCIP responses are not cut off.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options carrying the module's system properties: port, log level, request timeout in milliseconds, and the JWT token cache settings.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the gateway the edge module calls, supplied as -Dokapi_url in JAVA_OPTIONS.

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE
EnvVars.description: Secure store type for institutional user credentials (Ephemeral, AwsSsm or Vault), supplied as -Dsecure_store in JAVA_OPTIONS.

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_PROPS
EnvVars.description: Path to a properties file with the secure store configuration, supplied as -Dsecure_store_props in JAVA_OPTIONS.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Keystore type for the HTTP server TLS, such as JKS, PKCS12 or BCFKS; set to enable server TLS.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Keystore file location for the HTTP server TLS.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Keystore password for the HTTP server TLS.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEY_ALIAS
EnvVars.description: Key alias within the server keystore.

EnvVars.name: SPRING_SSL_BUNDLE_JKS_WEBSERVER_KEY_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the server key alias, if the key is protected.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the web client that calls FOLIO.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORETYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore type for the web client, used when FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTOREPATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file location for the web client, used when FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true.

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTOREPASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the web client, used when FOLIO_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true.
